title: What it looks like trying to go one day without AI
title_candidates: What it looks like trying to go one day without AI
How it feels using the internet without AI right now
When you realize AI is already in everything you use
Every app you open has AI in it now
caption:
AI has quietly crept into almost every app, search engine, and website you use daily. Trying to go a single day without it is starting to feel impossible.

From autocomplete to photo editing to customer service chatbots, it's getting harder to use the internet without running into some form of AI. Most people don't even notice how many times a day it's already working in the background for them.
